name: Coats steroid CBG / Haga 2025 field-method comparison

dataset.exclusion_reason: Extra deposited compound omitted from the 31-row published Table 2; no residual-based exclusions.
dataset.activity_transformation: pActivity = -stored_pKi_CBG; verify against every published Table 2 value
dataset.redistribution: Permission not established; do not bundle the upstream SDF. Fetch pinned bytes explicitly for local benchmark execution.

article.license: CC BY 4.0; Haga et al. Pharmaceuticals 2025, 18, 440

predeclared_limits: All presets and both activity sources are reported; no selection using test performance.
Table 1 is used rather than inconsistent numerical comparisons in the article narrative.
Native default uses nested 3-fold evaluation, not the published selected-count LOO estimate.
Reference-like fixed-count LOO results are conditional historical comparisons, not unbiased estimates after component tuning.
The paper does not unambiguously distinguish per-field-block from per-column scaling; report both training-only interpretations for SEH.
Never combine test and training data to fit scaling or filtering, even though article Methods 4.6 describes doing so.
Aligned heavy-atom positions are preserved; hydrogens are regenerated by the existing preparation path.
Grid bounds use outer-training molecules only, and the grid origin convention differs from the article's snapping description.
Gaussian donor/acceptor features remain atom-centred, not the article's directional pseudoatoms.
Source activities near 5 may be assay-floor values; reproduce the tabulated point convention without asserting uncensored experimental accuracy.
Approximate numerical agreement alone does not establish an exact historical method reproduction or general validation.
